description: MAD LOOP grade + gated-wallet hook: grade a Morpho Blue position on Robinhood Chain (4663) before any loop leg signs — health factor, liquidation price, distance to liquidation, PASS / WARN / DONT_SIGN with reasons. Zero borrow prints as a state (CLOSED), never infinite health. As a hook, pass signer + fingerprint + effect (market in effect.loop.market_id) and the answer carries hook_verdict PASS / DONT_SIGN; a hook that cannot grade fails closed. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.
